items.title: A compatible map of structure sheaves of thickenings comes from a unique morphism of thickenings over the base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces), section on first order thickenings of algebraic spaces
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is about thickenings X subset X' and Y subset Y' of algebraic spaces over a base B and a morphism f : X -> Y: given a map of O_B-algebras alpha from f_{spaces,etale}^{-1}O_{Y'} to O_{X'} that makes the square with f^sharp, i_Y^sharp and i_X^sharp commute, it produces a unique morphism of thickenings f' lifting f with (f')^sharp = alpha (statement lines 1600-1621). The proof routes everything through the fully faithful embedding of thickenings into ringed topoi: one must show that (f_{spaces,etale}, alpha) is a morphism of locally ringed topoi, which uses the commutativity of the square and the local nilpotence of the kernels of the two closed immersions (proof lines 1624-1642). The content is therefore in the verification of the locally ringed condition rather than in a construction; the author leaves two routine verifications to the reader, the commuting square and the statement that f' is over B (proof lines 1642-1645). H2.
